_note: The ONE launch switch. gate: false = the game is open (preseason until Season 1 starts on seasonStart; everyone resets then). gate: true would hide the game and Tools pages behind an 'Opens Nov 9' card again. After changing gate: run `node scripts/sync-nav.mjs` (and `node scripts/build-pages.mjs` for generated pages) and commit.
_regate: assets/launch.js is no longer loaded by any page (removed for the preseason so pages don't pause). To re-gate, add <script src="assets/launch.js"></script> back to the <head> of each gated page, then set gate: true.
